english.title: Importer fail to ensure cat F1/F2/F3 firework accompanied by instructions / safety information in English
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was the importer of a category

(A)_[F1]_
(B)_[F2]_
(C)_[F3]_

firework and placed it on the market having failed to ensure that it was accompanied by instructions and safety information that was clear, legible and in easily understandable English
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 18, 62(2)(e) and 63(1) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being an importer
placed a cat F1/F2/F3 firework on market
failed to ensure it was accompanied by instructions / safety information
that were clear / legible / understandable in English

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
